scope: Independent physics and assessment review of four fluids corrections

decisions.quiz2: Accepted: distinguishes displaced volume from available water-excluding hull volume, restricts upright/static positive-freeboard criterion, distinguishes load versus lost displacement and excludes capsizing/flood-rate inference.
decisions.quiz4: Accepted: equal liquid density and 20× dynamic viscosity make vt and tau/t95 each 1/20 in the explicit memoryless particle-inertia model; low Re alone is not claimed to make that model exact.
decisions.quiz8: Accepted: distinguishes local Reynolds number indicator, widening/decelerating far-field scaling and actual turbulence onset; no universal threshold or resolved-eddy claim.
decisions.quiz9: Accepted: zero-top-pressure 10.33 m is a hypothetical bound with explicit pressure/density/g; ordinary vapour pressure/losses/capillarity/tension distinctions remain.
